about: Fictional 2-week caregiver vignettes for the CMAI agreement study. Raters must NOT see this file (it has design notes). Each event is one caregiver tap: itemId + UTC timestamp. Window: windowStart inclusive to windowEnd exclusive.
dayNumbering: Narratives use Day 1-14 (Day 1 = Monday 2026-01-05). JSON 'day' fields are 0-13.

vignettes.name: Ruth
vignettes.setting: 84, moderate Alzheimer's disease, assisted-living memory unit
vignettes.designNotes: Low band. #13 is one scream fully explained by the hot water; the expanded form (p.24) says not to include rare behaviors clearly explained by situational factors, so a manual rater may give 1 while the app counts it (2).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Harold
vignettes.designNotes: Irregular weeks: all 9 cursing events in week 2. The manual (p.4 instruction 10, p.5) says to average over two weeks: 4.5 per week = several times a week (4). Tests whether raters average or rate the recent week (which would be 5).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Edith
vignettes.setting: 88, dementia with Lewy bodies, nursing home
vignettes.designNotes: Near-boundary counts. #5 has N=5 (2.5 per week): the app gives 4, a rater may say 'once or twice a week' (3). #24 has N=13 (every day but one): the app gives 4, a rater may say 'once or twice a day' (5).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Walter
vignettes.designNotes: Clean mid-band case. #26 is a continuous behavior logged as two stretches a day (N=28, top of band 5). #19 at once every other day (N=7).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Margaret
vignettes.designNotes: Near-boundary count. #6 is 'twice a day' with one extra (N=29): the app crosses into 6, a rater will likely say 'once or twice a day' (5). #13 at 10 nights in 14 (N=10).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Frank
vignettes.setting: 73, early-onset Alzheimer's disease, physically strong, secure dementia unit
vignettes.designNotes: Band 6 for two items. #11 repeats the N=5 boundary from V03 in an aggressive-adjacent item.
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Dorothy
vignettes.designNotes: Clustered-hour case. #6 has 4 rounds inside 20 minutes on 9 of 14 days: the app gives 7. A rater may give 7 (several times an hour) or 6 (several times a day, since it happens in one hour only). #26 has bursts on 6 days, one short of the app's 7-day threshold: the app gives 5 from the count (26), a rater may give 6 or 7.
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: George
vignettes.setting: 85, Alzheimer's disease with night waking, nursing home
vignettes.designNotes: Clustered-hour case that crosses midnight. #13 has 3 screams within 35 minutes on 8 nights, which meets the spirit of the rating-7 rule (3+ in 60 min on 7+ days). The engine groups logs by calendar day, so every cluster is split at midnight and no day counts as clustered: the app gives 5 from the count (24).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Evelyn
vignettes.setting: 87, vascular dementia after a stroke, nursing home
vignettes.designNotes: Codes 8 and 9. #1 pacing is prevented by the lap tray: manual code 8 (p.3, p.5, p.24). #4 and #6 need words and she cannot speak: code 9 (p.3). The engine can only output 1 for an item with no logs; 8 and 9 exist only at the day-14 review (spec section 5).
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Leonard
vignettes.setting: 80, mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease, assisted living
vignettes.designNotes: Logging error, not a rule question. Spitting into a napkin is excluded from #3 (p.12, p.24), so a manual rater gives 1; the app counts the two mistaken taps (3). Analyze separately from rule cases.
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.

vignettes.name: Joan
vignettes.designNotes: Aggressive factor spread across bands 2-5. #7 at exactly twice a week (N=4).

vignettes.name: Albert
vignettes.designNotes: Irregular weeks the other way: behavior front-loaded. #13 is 4 a day for one week, none the next (average 2 a day, 5). #22 is 14 events packed into 4 days (average 1 a day, 5); a rater may say 'several times a week' (4) because it happened on only 4 days.
vignettes.authorPredictionNote: The author's guess of what a manual-only rater would give. Not an answer key; never shown to raters.
